gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3918 covers floor coverings of plastics in rolls or tiles; chapter 39 note 9 defines them
GRI 6: 3918.10 of polymers of vinyl chloride; floor coverings; Vinyl tile; 3918.10.10.40 Other (not rigid-core)

rejected_alternatives.reason: requires a rigid solid polymer core, which is not stated
requires a rigid expanded polymer core of the kind in statistical note 2; not stated
other floor coverings; tiles are provided for by the vinyl tile line

missing_facts: Whether the tile has a rigid solid or expanded core (SPC/WPC style), which would change the suffix to .20 or .30
classification.rationale: A PVC floor tile is a plastic floor covering in the form of tiles under heading 3918 and 3918.10 vinyl tile. N034816 classified vinyl flooring tiles in the vinyl tile line. With no rigid core stated, the 'Other' suffix is used.
